items.title: Tesla to end Cybertruck production as sales stall at ~10% of plan
items.raw_content: Tesla is ending Cybertruck production. CEO Elon Musk announced early Friday that the automaker will “wind down” the electric pickup at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of 2027, about three and a half years after the first deliveries. Musk says it’s to make room for more Cybercab production. But Giga Texas isn’t short on space. The Cybertruck is short on buyers, and it sells at roughly a tenth of the 250,000 units a year Tesla built its line for. more…
items.title_zh: 特斯拉将停产 Cybertruck，销量仅为计划的约 10%
items.summary: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around mid-2027, CEO Elon Musk said, after sales ran at roughly a tenth of the 250,000-unit annual capacity; Musk framed the move as making room for more Cybercab output.

items.title: BYD’s electric hypercar hits 312 mph, first production car over 500 km/h
items.raw_content: BYD’s Yangwang U9 Xtreme just reached 503.17 km/h (312.66 mph) on a closed highway in Abu Dhabi, making it the first production car ever to go faster than 500 km/h. The FIA and Guinness World Records both recognized the run. It’s the all-electric hypercar’s second top-speed record in just over a year, and the one it broke was its own. more…
items.title_zh: 比亚迪仰望 U9 Xtreme 时速达 503 公里，成为首款突破 500 km/h 的量产车
items.summary: BYD's Yangwang U9 Xtreme reached 503.17 km/h (312.66 mph) on a closed highway in Abu Dhabi, a run recognized by the FIA and Guinness World Records as the first production car to exceed 500 km/h.
